title: carex depressa subsp. basilaris
intro: Carex depressa subsp. basilaris, commonly known as  Mountain Sedge, is a subspecies of sedge found in the mountainous regions of North America. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The Mountain Sedge has been traditionally used to relieve coughs and congestion, with its therapeutic actions also making it useful for treating conditions such as bronchitis and asthma.
